dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave spline fitting the trailing edge from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded geometry with an obtuse profile at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderately steep convex gradient approximately 50 degrees from the horizontal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Moderate convexity with a continuous smooth arc from the blowhole to the cranial inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt rostrum with proportional thickness nearly equal to visible length from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle where the melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notch visible on the posterior margin of the dorsal fin near the base.
